game_narrative: The game opened with careful positional maneuvering, where White sought to utilize the bishop pair and queenside pawn majority, while Black developed counterplay with a fianchettoed bishop and stable central control. Positional tension increased as both players maneuvered for control of central and queenside squares; Black prepared for counterattack with b5 and developed latent pressure along the c-file and central diagonals.
